svg.title: Smart Warehouse Planner: screen map plate, all key screens as catalogue figures
svg.text: Smart Warehouse Planner · plan Spring re-slot 2026 · data as of 2026-09-30 · Fig. 8 and Fig. 12 drawn full size
Plans save automatically and reopen exactly as they were left.
“twelve” is not a number. Fix the file and upload it again.
Nothing is saved until all three files pass.
Select a part to see its locations, or make a manual move.
Walk Path is an ordering only, not a distance.
Two parts with 5 or more shared jobs; each is the other's partner.
Aisle B: level 1 marked (heavy frame). Click a cell to mark one location.
Before = the import. After = the planning copy. Current best marks.
From-location before to-location; a tick box per line.
